Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA-> ------------------------- The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the offered Portable SO2 Gas Monitor or an authorized dealer/distributor/Channel Partner of the OEM. In case o f an authorized dealer/distributor, a valid authorization letter issued by the OEM, specifically for this tender/enquiry, shall be submitted along with the bid. The bidder should have successfully supplied at least one Portable SO2 Gas Monitor or Portable CO/O2/Multi-Gas Detector equipped with at least one SO2 gas sensor, during the last seven (07) years ending on the last day of the month preceding the month in which the tender is issued, to any Central/State Government Organization, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), Joint Venture Company having at least one Central/State Government Organization or PSU as a partner, or Public Limited Company. The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of the relevant Purchase Order and documentary evidence of successful supply, such as a delivery challan, tax invoice or inspection report. In case the bidder has supplied the qualifying equipment to SAIL/Rourkela Steel Plant, the relevant Purchase Order number may be fur nished for verification against available records. REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION-> -------------------- Procurement of SO2 Portable Gas monitor for Coal Chemicals Department.

SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS-> -------------------- 1.MONOGRAM OF THE SUPPLIER/OEM SHALL BE VISIBLY ETCHED/ EMBOSSED/ TAGGED ON THE BODY OF THE MATERIAL FOR EASY IDENTIFICATION. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED : a) GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE b) MONITOR TEST CERTIFICATE/ CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE BY SUPPLIER/OEM. 2.THE TENDERER HAS TO SUBMIT DETAILS OF OFFERED PORTABLE SO2 MONITOR (MAKE, MODEL, TECH SPECIFICATIONS CONFORMING TO TENDER,WEIGHT. OF MONITOR INCLUDING ITS BATTERY-<(><<)>500 GRAM(MAX.) ALONG WITH BID. 3.THE SENSOR LIFE SHOULD BE MINIMUM 24 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY OF MONITORS AGAINST THE A/T. 4. THE PARTY HAS TO GIVE FREE DEMONSTRATION OF THEIR SUPPLIED SO2 MONITORS WITH RESPECT TO ITS OPEARTION AND MAINTENANCE AT INDENTOR'S SITE AFTER DRAWAL OF MATERIAL FROM STORES AFTER GARN. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT -------------------- THE TOTAL LOT OF PORTABLE SO2 MONITORS:5 NOS. TO BE DELIVERED WITHIN 60 DAYS OF ORDER PLACEMENTAT RSP STORES. GUARANTEE CLAUSE-> -------------------- 12 MONTHS FROM DATE OF USE OR 18 MONTHS FROM DATE OF SUPPLY, WHICHEVER IS EARLIER. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE -> -------------------- FIRM TILL DELIVERY

PACKAGING CLAUSE-> -------------------- EACH MATERIAL TO BE SUPPLIED ALONG WITH OPERATING MANUAL & CARRYING CASE PACKED IN SUITABLE PACKING SO AS TO AVOID DAMAGE DURING TRANSIT AND HANDLING. INSPECTION AGENCY-> -------------------- JOINT INSPECTION BY INDENTOR AND MM-INSPECTION. INSPECTION TERM-> ___________________________ JOINT INSPECTION BY MM-INSPECTION AND INDENTOR AFTER RECEIPT OF THE MATERIAL AT RSP STORES w r t (a)GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE (b) SUPPLIER'S TEST CERTIFICATE/ CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE OF SUPPLIED PORTABLE SO2 MONITORS. PLACE OF INSPECTION-> ___________________________ AT RSP STORES AFTER RECEIPT OF MATERIALS. VERIFICATION OF CREDENTIALS 1. If any document is found fake/forged/tampered/non-genuine at any stage, the tender er/bidder is liable for punitive actions as per extant guidelines of SAIL.

IMPORTANT NOTES 1. RSP reserves the right to reject the offer of any bidder on the basis of unsatisfactory perfor mance in respect of quality, delivery, etc. or any other adverse information received or gat hered. 2. In case any adverse report is received against a tenderer, as an information or upon enquiry made by SAIL, in respect of capabilities or performance of the tenderer after receipt of tend er, or even after opening of price bid, the quotation/tender submitted by the tenderer is lia ble to be rejected. 3. RPN Clause: In case of failure to perform within the agreed delivery period (other tha n force majeure), RSP may initiate Risk Purchase after giving 14–30 days’ notice, at t he risk and cost of the supplier. 4. Any price differential shall be recoverable from pending bills across SAIL units. 5. RSP may place back-up orders against GeM contracts. The back-up order number sha ll be mentioned in invoices. 6. Bids are liable to be rejected if required certificates/documents are not uploaded. 7. Delivery period shall be strictly as per GeM bid document. 8. Latest Udyam Registration Certificate shall be submitted for MSE preference. 9. Make in India declaration indicating Class-I / Class-II status shall be submitted. 10.
